commands: set -euo pipefail; B='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar'; APK='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-db8c3ce.apk'; test "$(shasum -a 256 "$B" | awk '{print $1}')" = '2dadcc5a56f23adaa99e23655bc101f9261a5f0fa659f01d04c1aa4f05b42582'; test "$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')" = '4d4a58789fb94d5e984d2135c2942018f4d8ae0cfb06d6f49692a0a454941ace'; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-in run-as io.blueeye tar xf - < "$B"; echo RESTORED_FILES; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -l databases; SNAP=$(mktemp); D=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -f "$SNAP"; rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye tar cf - databases > "$SNAP"; tar xf "$SNAP" -C "$D"; echo DB_VERIFY_BEFORE_LAUNCH; sqlite3 "$D/databases/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n io.blueeye/.MainActivity; sleep 3; echo PID; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye; P=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -n1); TMP=$(mktemp); adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$P" "$TMP" >/dev/null; HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}'); rm -f "$TMP"; echo installed_sha256=$HASH; test "$HASH" = '4d4a58789fb94d5e984d2135c2942018f4d8ae0cfb06d6f49692a0a454941ace'; SNAP2=$(mktemp); D2=$(mktemp -d); adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye tar cf - databases > "$SNAP2"; tar xf "$SNAP2" -C "$D2"; echo DB_VERIFY_AFTER_LAUNCH; sqlite3 "$D2/databases/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;'; rm -f "$SNAP2"; rm -rf "$D2"; echo RESTORE_AND_INSTALL_PASS
